signal: The SaaS affiliate market crossed $17B in 2026 with B2B SaaS and AI products commanding the highest partner lifetime values

email.subject1: a signal play for your partner ecosystem
email.body1:
Jason, with the SaaS affiliate market crossing $17B this year, partner-led growth is suddenly where the leverage is, and that is squarely your remit at Affiliate.com.

A partner ecosystem scaling that fast usually means more co-sell targets than your team can personally cover, so partner-sourced pipeline plateaus right when it should compound. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage across partner accounts scales to 3-5x more meetings without new headcount.

I built a signal play for your partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals across your SaaS base. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jason, quick follow-up on the partner side for Affiliate.com.

Most partner teams know which programs drive revenue but can't put enough reps against co-sell motions to actually work the accounts. That coverage gap is where partner-sourced pipeline leaks, and it widens as you sign more SaaS partners.

I sketched a co-sell pilot playbook for running outbound into your top partner accounts without adding heads. Want to grab 15 minutes so I can walk you through it?
email.body3:
Jason, last bit of proof for Affiliate.com.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I also pulled a pipeline gap analysis on how much co-sell coverage your ecosystem could add. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jason, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Ecosystem growth and co-sell coverage rarely move on the same timeline, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through three personalized drafts to your top partner targets plus an AI-SDR co-sell play? I will tailor it to Affiliate.com either way.
